record_identity.title: Durable work-state, checkpoint and resumable agent execution controls

summary: Implements the CAM-side repair for FM-0018 by requiring proportionate recoverable work state for materially consequential agent execution, safe-boundary pause and resumable interruption handling, persistence-budget reservation, checkpoint and delivery-posture records, and an exact infrastructure-continuity failure class. The repair establishes minimum recoverability rather than guaranteed task success; pull-request creation is neither the first nor the only acceptable durability boundary.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: Material work already performed should not disappear merely because a final administrative operation, quota window, session, device, network, authentication state, tool, or platform runtime fails. The repair distinguishes substantive processing from durable delivery and preserves temporary branches, patches, checkpoints, and resumable workspaces as recovery artefacts without treating them as user approval, merge authority, deployment authority, or final adoption.

decision_trace.decision_summary: Current-corpus review confirmed that adjacent continuity, access-state, logging, and resource doctrine did not expressly require a recoverable work state before interruption risk became material. The approved repair was placed in runtime execution integrity, operational recordkeeping, and the existing Infrastructure & Continuity failure family; final Arbitration was not expanded.
